F_mahact/airo-shir-aur-benediction/5.1.na: Benediction leaves a gravity rift through direct_move.apply_moves -> movement.roll_rift_exit(position=source), which already skips the Vuil'raith's own Dimensional Tear (RULES.md 62.17, tested in test_cabal) - RULES.md 62.23.

F_mahact/airo-shir-aur-benediction/9.1.na: The Mahact is the active player of its component action; every combat window prompts players in order starting after the active player and the Mahact answers its own offers at any time, so no attacker/defender ordering is applied (RULES.md 54, 62.23).

F_mahact/airo-shir-aur-benediction/12.na: Combat secret objectives are checked by objective_events.on_combat_end for the combat's attacker and defender, whatever started the combat; Benediction uses the same battle engine (RULES.md 62.23).

F_mahact/airo-shir-aur-benediction/12.1.na: objective_events.on_combat_end only scores for the two sides of the combat; a Mahact that moved two other players' fleets is neither side (RULES.md 62.23).

F_yssaril/mageon-implants/2.1.na: Oral claims are table talk outside the engine; the looked-at cards stay only in the Yssaril's decision (offer inputs are projected to the decider only) - RULES.md 62.22.

F_yssaril/ssruu/2.na: Captain Mendosa copied by Ssruu is its own offer on the same SYSTEM_ACTIVATED window (saar.captain_mendosa); the move value is read once when the ship moves, so the copy and the Saar's own use may be resolved in either order (RULES.md 62.22).

F_yssaril/ssruu/3.na: The Stillness of Stars copied by Ssruu is a separate offer to the Yssaril on the same commodities window (SOURCE_LEADER of the copied agent); offers resolve in window order from the active player and each capture reads the target's reinforcements at that moment (RULES.md 62.22, 61.5).

F_yssaril/ssruu/5.na: Trillossa Aun Mirik, Emissary Taivra and Doctor Sucaban grant a permission/effect for that timing window; a second use (the Ssruu copy) in the same window sets the same permission again - the engine has nothing to stack (RULES.md 62.22).

F_yssaril/deepgloom-executable/2.1.na: The granted transaction (transaction.grant_pair, Duration.PHASE) works in any phase and needs no active player or neighbours - the Suffi An example in the strategy phase uses the same grant (RULES.md 62.22).

F_nomad/ahksyl-siven-probability-matrix/.na: Time Warp is an ActiveEffect with Duration.ROUND, which expires on ROUND/END - fired by turn_flow when the game round ends after the agenda phase (or the status phase while the custodians token is on Mecatol Rex) (RULES.md 62.21).

F_nomad/future-sight/3.na: Deadly Plot discards the agenda without resolving it (agenda_phase: no AGENDA_OUTCOME_RESOLVED event), so the Future Sight hook never fires (RULES.md 62.21).

F_nomad/navarch-feng/1.1.na: Navarch Feng only leaves the flagship out of the order's total (production.free_types); Integrated Economy and Umbat read the unit's cost from the data, which stays 8 (RULES.md 62.21).

F_nomad/navarch-feng/1.2.na: Scuttle reads the unit's cost from the data (8); Navarch Feng does not change it (RULES.md 62.21).

F_nomad/navarch-feng/2.1.na: The unlock reads PlayerState.scored_secrets; a secret made public by Classified Document Leaks is not a scored secret, and a discarded law changes nothing there (RULES.md 62.21).

F_nomad/quantum-manipulator/1.1.na: Effects that destroy a ship directly (Assault Cannon, Direct Hit) never create hits in the assignment, so there is nothing the hit shield could cancel (RULES.md 62.21).

F_nomad/the-cavalry/2.2.na: The status phase repairs every damaged unit (damage.repair_all), whatever its abilities (RULES.md 62.21).

F_nomad/the-cavalry/2.3.na: Duranium Armor repairs any damaged unit of the group (damage counts per group); without The Cavalry a cruiser has no SUSTAIN DAMAGE, so it cannot be damaged again (battle_units.sustainable) (RULES.md 62.21).

F_nomad/the-thundarian/2.1.na: Magen Defense Grid, Fighter Prototype, Morale Boost, Munitions Reserves, Supercharge, War Funding and the round-long agents are ActiveEffects with Duration.COMBAT_ROUND; battle.rewind_roll_step keeps the round number, so they stay (RULES.md 62.21).

F_nomad/the-thundarian/3.1.na: battle.rewind_roll_step returns to step ROLL of the same round without _open_round: no COMBAT_ROUND/START window is replayed, and round-end windows only open after the next assignment (RULES.md 62.21).

F_nomad/the-thundarian/4.1.na: The Thundarian is a window use available only in the assignment step after the 'after roll' decisions (battle.roll_step_open); the rewind discards the boosted dice, the trade goods spent on Wrath of Kenara are not refunded and a new Kenara offer comes with the new roll (RULES.md 62.21).

F_nomad/the-thundarian/4.2.na: The Crown of Thalnos reroll is applied to the roll entries that battle.rewind_roll_step discards; destroyed units stay destroyed, the +1 is gone with the old roll (RULES.md 62.21).

F_nomad/the-thundarian/4.3.na: Fire Team is discarded when played (action_cards) and its reroll changes the roll entries that the rewind discards - it has no effect on the new roll (RULES.md 62.21).

F_nomad/the-thundarian/4.4.na: War Funding returns to Letnev when played (promissory_play._dispose); its rerolls change the roll entries the rewind discards (RULES.md 62.21).

F_ul/slumberstate-computing/3.1.gap: Binding deals are not modelled in the engine (core/transaction.py has no deal/agreement item) - a sleeper placement cannot be part of a binding deal.

R_frontier_tokens/notes/2.na: No tile in the active assets has a space station without planets. The only SPACESTATION planet, 'loststation', is in no system tile. game_setup.place_frontier_tokens skips any system with a non-empty planets list, so it would also skip a station-only tile if one were added.

C_action_cards/lie-in-wait/1.na: A deal for a player to play an action card is an agreement outside the rules; the engine has no such transaction component. Lie In Wait is an optional window after the transaction and reads the live hand, so any card played earlier is already gone when it resolves.

C_promissory_notes/support-for-the-thron.na: Flavor text ('a betrayal most foul'); no mechanical effect. The mechanical half is covered by support-for-the-throne/8.

C_agendas/public-execution/2.reason: Public Execution during the action phase comes from Keleres' Executive Order technology. Keleres is not implemented, so the agenda cannot resolve in the action phase.

C_agendas/classified-document-leaks/8.reason: The Firmament control token on the elected secret objective. Firmament is not implemented.

C_agendas/ixthian-artifact/6.na: Flavor ruling (voting against or riding on Ixthian Artifact "is to commit heresy"); it has no mechanical effect.

C_agendas/miscount-disclosed/7.na: Holy Planet of Ixth, Shard of the Throne and The Crown of Emphidia were removed in Prophecy of Kings; those base-game agendas are not in the active decks.

C_units/war-sun/2.na: Refers to the base Magen Defense Grid exhaust ability (needs a unit with PLANETARY SHIELD); only Magen Defense Grid ΩΩ is in play (technologies_combat.MAGEN_ALIAS, superseded md_base/md_c1) and its structure-based text has no Planetary Shield condition.

C_action_cards/sabotage/3.na: User decision (2026-11-26): the Sabotage window opens immediately when an action card is played, before deciding targets, technologies, or variable costs.

C_action_cards/experimental-battlestatio.na: Ships cannot leave the active system in the Move Ships step (it holds the active player's command token), so the engine never moves a ship out and back in during one move step.

F_creuss/creuss-iff/2.gap: Binding deals are not modelled in the engine (core/transaction.py has no deal/agreement item) - a promise about where a wormhole token goes is table talk, never enforced (RULES.md 62.19).

F_creuss/wormhole-generator-replaced-by-.na: The active assets hold only the Wormhole Generator Ω text (ACTION, exhaust) - technologies:wg; the replaced version is not in play (RULES.md 62.19).
Mandatory status-phase placement belongs to the replaced (non-Ω) Wormhole Generator, not in the active assets; Ω is an ACTION (RULES.md 62.19).

F_creuss/hil-colish/6.na: A retreat moves all retreating ships of the player together to one chosen system (core/retreat.py) - the only outcome the ruling allows (the flagship cannot leave the others unable to reach the same system).

F_empyrean/watcher/6.gap: Research action cards ask for the technology when they are played (the card form), i.e. before the hold window the Watcher answers; announcing it later is not modelled (RULES.md 62.20).

F_empyrean/watcher/7.na: Only the play of a card opens the hold window (core/card_hold.begin); a rider resolving later is not a new play, so nothing can be cancelled then - the ruling holds by construction (RULES.md 62.20).

R_exhausted/notes/1.1.reason: Space stations and The Triad are tested (test_rulings_exhaust_ready.py); Deepwrought ocean cards need the Deepwrought faction module.

R_readied/notes/2.1.reason: Space stations and The Triad are tested (test_rulings_exhaust_ready.py); Deepwrought ocean cards need the Deepwrought faction module.

R_movement/notes/7.na: Binding deals are not modelled in the engine (core/transaction.py has no deal/agreement item), so no deal can grant passage; movement_paths.passage_blocked has no deal exception.

R_abilities/rules-reference/1.na: The engine has one rules source, the LRR dump in docs/rules_tirules/. The Learn to Play booklet is not a source, so there is nothing to override.

R_abilities/rules-reference/3.na: Describes how abilities are written. Each hook is registered at the (event, moment) window its text names (rules_hooks.on_event, RULES.md 54.1).

R_abilities/rules-reference/4.na: Describes card layout. Separate paragraphs are separate hooks or effects (see notes/4).

R_abilities/rules-reference/6.gap: No generic 'cannot' arbitration. FORBID hooks are unioned per point (rules_hooks.forbidden), but PERMIT hooks and per-card checks are resolved locally, so nothing guarantees a 'cannot' cannot be overridden.

R_abilities/rules-reference/6.1.gap: No precedence model between two 'cannot' abilities (persistent over one-time, enabling over cancel). Each conflicting pair is handled, if at all, inside the card hooks.

R_abilities/rules-reference/9.na: Text-semantics rule applied per component when its effect is implemented (pipeline ARCHITEKTURA_KODU.md §3a). It is verified by that component's own @ruling tests; there is no generic 'and' mechanism to test.

R_abilities/rules-reference/15.na: Text-semantics rule ('then') applied per component when its effect is implemented (ARCHITEKTURA_KODU.md §3a). It is verified by the component's own @ruling tests; there is no generic mechanism.

R_abilities/rules-reference/21.na: Agenda outcome effects are registered per outcome (register_effect 'agendas:<id>') and run only from agenda_phase._resolve after the votes are counted (tests/test_agenda_effects.py, test_rulings_agendas*.py).

R_abilities/rules-reference/22.na: Describes faction sheets. Faction abilities and flagships are hook sources owned while the faction is in play (rules_hooks.owned_sources).

R_abilities/notes/4.na: Text-semantics rule applied per component (each paragraph is its own hook or effect step). It is verified by the component's @ruling sentence tests ('<kind>:<id>#n'); there is no generic paragraph model.

R_abilities/notes/5.gap: Target pools are built per card (register_effect_inputs). No audit checks that 'a player' wording includes the resolving player and only 'another player' excludes them.

R_abilities/notes/7.gap: No generic guard against re-triggering an ability inside a window it opened. triggers._MAX_DEPTH only stops runaway recursion.

R_abilities/notes/8.1.gap: The REACTION window serves one player's offers in a row (RULES.md 54.7a, triggers._advance_window). Interleaving one ability per player happens only through triggers.repeat_offer (Exotrireme II, Devotion).

R_abilities/notes/8.2.gap: Same as notes/8.1: the Alice #1, Bob #1, Cheng #1, Alice #2 interleaving is not modelled. Alice resolves all her offers before Bob gets his turn.

R_abilities/notes/8.4.gap: A declined offer is removed (triggers.decline_offer), and the window never reopens to a player who declined, even when a later player resolves an ability.

R_abilities/notes/12.reason: Granted unit abilities have no separate representation to test against an ability shutdown; the reference case (Quietus) needs the Crimson Rebellion faction module.

R_abilities/notes/12.1.reason: The Quietus (Crimson Rebellion flagship) shutting down granted unit abilities needs the Crimson faction module. The Argent commander combo should be tested together with it.

R_coexistence/notes/2.2.gap: No effect makes the controller coexist on its own planet. coexistence.choose ignores the controller (ASSUMPTION RULES.md 40.1 I7b), so control never passes to another player this way.

R_coexistence/notes/3.na: The only 'may choose to coexist' effect in the engine is Slumberstate Computing, resolved by the active Titans player alone in the Awaken window. No window has two players choosing.

R_coexistence/notes/7.gap: Control is sticky (RULES.md 23). A coexisting player left alone on a planet does not gain control automatically; this is listed as not modelled in RULES.md 40.1 I7b and handled by operator/God-Mode.

R_coexistence/notes/7.1.gap: Same as notes/7: when the controller moves all its units off the planet outside an invasion, control does not pass immediately to the coexisting player.

R_coexistence/notes/7.3.gap: Depends on notes/2.2: no effect puts the controller into coexistence when ground forces are committed, so this case cannot arise.

R_coexistence/notes/7.4.gap: Same as notes/7: there is no control hand-off to the next coexisting player in ability-resolution order (initiative in the action phase, otherwise clockwise).

F_nekro/technological-singularity/4.1.na: Combat dice are rolled and their hits counted at roll time (ActiveCombat.rolls); a technology gained afterwards only changes the CombatUnit values rebuilt for later rolls (test_singularity_ulepszenie_dziala_od_razu, RULES.md 62.24).

F_nekro/technological-singularity/4.2.na: battle_units.combat_units rebuilds every unit from the state at each step, so an upgrade gained in the AFB Assign Hits step is in effect for that round's combat rolls (same mechanism as ruling 4, RULES.md 62.24).

F_nekro/technological-singularity/4.3.na: Same rebuild-from-state mechanism: an AFB upgrade gained at the start of combat is read by battle.resolve_afb from the current unit variant (RULES.md 62.24).

F_nekro/technological-singularity/4.4.na: Sustain Damage is read from the unit variant when hits are assigned (battle_units.combat_units), so a sustain upgrade gained after Direct Hit cancels that round's hits (RULES.md 62.24).

F_nekro/technological-singularity/5.gap: Offers of a window are created when the event fires; a technology gained inside the same window (e.g. start of combat) does not get its own offer for that already-fired window (RULES.md 62.24).

F_nekro/technological-singularity/5.1.gap: Same as 5: a Valefar copy of Dimensional Splicer placed during the start-of-combat window is not offered in that window.

F_nekro/technological-singularity/6.gap: Infantry II rolls are offered on each infantry's own UNIT_DESTROYED; an Infantry II gained by Singularity after the same hit assignment does not retroactively roll for infantry destroyed in that step (RULES.md 62.24).

F_nekro/technological-singularity/6.1.gap: Same as 6: infantry destroyed in the Direct Hit assign step do not roll for an Infantry II gained in that step.

F_nekro/technological-singularity/6.2.na: Infantry destroyed by Strike Wing Alpha II are destroyed in the AFB roll, before any Singularity gain of the following Assign Hits step - they simply go to reinforcements (engine order, RULES.md 62.24).

F_nekro/valefar-assimilator/6.2.gap: Units waiting on an Infantry II card are not transferred between the generic card and a copied faction infantry upgrade (no per-card tracking of returning infantry yet, RULES.md 62.24).

F_nekro/valefar-assimilator/10.na: Heading of rulings 10.1-10.6 (no rule of its own).

F_nekro/valefar-assimilator/10.1.gap: Floating Factory II + Vortex on one Nekro: the blockade order (return captured units, then destroy the dock) is not combined for a single player holding both copies.

F_nekro/valefar-assimilator/10.2.gap: No stalemate detection: Non-Euclidean Shielding + Duranium Armor versus the Letnev never forces the attacker to retreat or be destroyed.

F_nekro/valefar-assimilator/10.3.na: Both copies are hook sources of the Nekro (owned_sources reads technologies): movement.into_supernova (Magmus Reactor) and the floating space docks (Floating Factory II) combine through the generic movement checks (RULES.md 62.24).

F_nekro/valefar-assimilator/10.4.na: A copied Floating Factory II makes the Nekro docks floating structures through the same hook source; the dock coexistence check is generic (floating_structures, RULES.md 62.14 / 62.24).

F_nekro/valefar-assimilator/10.5.gap: End-of-combat-round abilities of both players are offered in resolution order, not strictly alternating between the two Exotrireme II owners.

F_nekro/valefar-assimilator/10.6.reason: Radical Advancement belongs to the Deepwrought Scholarate (not implemented yet).

F_nekro/valefar-assimilator/11.1.gap: technology.release_assimilated handles a lost war sun upgrade only; losing a copied Floating Factory II does not move the space docks onto planets / back to reinforcements.

F_nekro/valefar-assimilator/11.3.na: Losing a copied Magmus Reactor removes the hook source; units already in a supernova stay (no rule removes them) and later moves check movement.into_supernova again (RULES.md 62.24).

F_nekro/valefar-assimilator/11.4.na: Dimensional Tear gravity rifts come from the dock variant (cabal._tear_positions / map.gravity_rifts): a released dt2 copy changes the variant back, so the systems stop being gravity rifts at once (RULES.md 62.24).

F_nekro/valefar-assimilator/11.5.gap: Same as 6.2: no per-card tracking of infantry waiting on an infantry upgrade card.

F_nekro/the-alastor/2.na: Start-of-combat offers are prompted in order starting after the active player (RULES.md 43.4); each ability's condition is re-checked when it resolves (Assault Cannon reads ship_roles.space_ships at that moment), RULES.md 62.24.

F_nekro/the-alastor/2.1.na: Example of 2 - Assault Cannon readiness is re-evaluated when the Nekro resolves it (technologies_combat._assault_cannon_ready).

F_nekro/the-alastor/4.gap: Only ground forces in the space area can be chosen; ground forces on planets cannot participate yet (the combat engine keeps one zone per unit type) - RULES.md 62.24 gap.

F_nekro/the-alastor/4.1.gap: Depends on 4 (ground forces on planets do not participate).

F_nekro/the-alastor/8.gap: PDS (Hel Titan II) are on planets - same gap as 4.

F_nekro/the-alastor/10.gap: Elimination is checked after the combat, not the moment the last ground force dies in a space combat.

F_nekro/valefar-assimilator-z/6.reason: Heaven's Eye and the Firmament plots are not implemented yet.

F_nekro/valefar-assimilator-z/7.reason: The Firmament / Obsidian flip is not implemented yet.
